facts.label: Passado e comparativos
facts.sub: Conte o passado com verbos regulares e irregulares: I saw a pelican. Compare com -er than: The light was softer in the morning than at noon.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para contar o que aconteceu, use o passado simples: I arrived early. Verbos regulares ganham -ed: walked, photographed. Alguns são irregulares: took, saw.

facts.label: Comparar
facts.sub: Para comparar adjetivos curtos, use -er + than: softer than, taller than, lighter than, longer than. Compare duas coisas, lugares ou pessoas.

compare.ask: It was lighter than my new one.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “mais suave que” e “mais leve que”.

items.s: The past of take is took.
The past of see is seed.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

answers: The past of take is took. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The past of see is seed. → Falso (It is saw.)
Softer than compares two things. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A quiet park · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Sunday morning in a park in Perth. Tall trees stand near a quiet lake. Marco sits on a bench with a camera. His friend Uri walks over from the path. He sees the camera on Marco’s knees. He asks about the photos.
“Hi, Marco! You took many photos in the park yesterday.” says Uri. “Yes! I arrived early. The light was softer in the morning than at noon.” says Marco. “What did you photograph first?” says Uri.
